# Supplied binary release

`AdaptiveTradingLab-windows-x64.zip` is the original user-supplied package,
preserved without modification. SHA-256:

`7D2583C60E0FAD11443859A8723288E2A8444A7F41D37C8A0047C6CC7052D695`

It contains a self-contained Windows x64 .NET 10.0.11 console demo and its
dependencies. Application source code and a license were not supplied. This
repository does not claim to rebuild those binaries. The original README and
launcher remain inside the archive. The editable Windows integration and
NinjaScript strategy live outside the archive.
